moisture_pct.quote: Sample: unspecified age, Netherlands, described as “typical analysis of the cheese” : moisture 40.6%, fat 13.5% and protein 37.3%.

fat_pct.quote: Sample: same unspecified “typical analysis”: moisture 40.6%, fat 13.5% and protein, 37.3%.

ph.quote: Sample: Leyden 40+, 5 weeks, The Netherlands, Chemical characteristics-at 14 days : pH approx. 5.2

ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination/deamidation in 3-4 mo washed-curd interior, no surface flora urease.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw farm milk and cumin terpenes give low p-cresol/indole/skatole from Tyr/Trp catabolism.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin and lactococcal peptidases, accentuated by low-fat and 2.5% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation or piercing, so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone beta-oxidation pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose/lactose and lysine during heating; dense low-moisture matrix browns moderately.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate-fermenting Lactococcus plus delta-lactones, lowered by partial skim 30-40% FDM.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipase/esterase release of butanoic, hexanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from milk triacylglycerols.

creaminess.reason: Low absolute fat ~18.5% and firm 42% moisture matrix reduce fat-globule lubrication and creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Low FDM plus pH 5.2 solubilizes colloidal calcium phosphate, shortening para-casein network to fracture.

firmness.reason: Low moisture, low fat, pressed flat loaf and salt-brining concentrate casein and calcium crosslinking.

floral_honey.reason: Very low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from Phe catabolism; caraway limonene adds only faint floral note.

fruity.reason: Limited ethyl butanoate/hexanoate synthesis due to low fat substrate and washed-curd low acidity.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched acids characteristic of goat lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal from Leu/Ile/Val plus cuminaldehyde/carvone from added cumin-caraway.

melt.reason: Rennet pH 5.2 demineralized para-casein flows on heating, but low fat and firm body limit complete fluidity.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Low 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleate oxidation; earthiness mainly cumin/caraway terpenes.

oil_off.reason: Low absolute fat and emulsified fat in pressed curd limit free-oil coalescence and oiling-off on melt.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked loaf; no lignin pyrolysis so no guaiacol/syringol unless smoked variant.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mesophilic starter lactic acid plus small acetic/propanoic acids; pH ~5.2 washed-curd acidity.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading at pH 5.1-5.3 to align casein fibers, so no long stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Mild methional/dimethyl sulfide/disulfide from Met catabolism; low-heat washed curd, no high cook.

sweet.reason: Most lactose fermented to lactate; faint sweetness from free Pro/Gly/Ala and low salt masking only.

umami.reason: Free glutamate from chymosin/plasmin and starter proteolysis during 4-month ripening.
